grip.label: Maia in Quaker's shape becomes record 47 (Grip's race number)
grip.explanation: Original: the fix-up marks race 47 (Grip, alive) dead instead of Quaker; on the next level the Borg counts 56 living uniques instead of 57, its first living unique becomes Fang and its hunted depth 41 instead of 17; it answers 'n' and the recall depth stays 60. Corrected: Quaker is marked, Grip stays alive, hunted depth 17, the Borg answers 'y' and the game sets recall depth (and maximum depth) to 15.

slot5.label: Control: the same sighting becomes record 5 (a non-unique race)
